description: Lists the DIYA-GL books saved in the person's DIY Accounting Submit account, most recently updated first. A DIYA-GL book holds one business's sales, purchases and bank lines. Each row gives the bookId that open_book takes, the book's title, its product and the period it covers. With clientId, lists that practice client's DIYA-GL books. Use this when the person asks about their VAT return, their MTD VAT or the quarter's VAT and no DIYA-GL book is open yet, or asks which DIYA-GL books they have saved. It does not open or change a book and does not contact HMRC.

clientId.description: A practice client's id, to list that client's books instead of the practice's own

name: list_books
title: List saved DIYA-GL books
